findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 27 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 25 questions numbered 1-25; by section: 27.1 5, 27.1.1 2, 27.2.1 3, 27.2.2 1, 27.3 2, 27.3.1 1, 27.3.2 1, 27.4.1 1, 27.4.2 1, 27.4.3 1, 27.4.4 1, 27.5 1, 27.5.1 2, 27.5.2 1, 27.5.3 1, u-minerals 1.

Theory parts cover monosaccharides, disaccharides, structural vs storage polysaccharides, nutritional importance of carbohydrates, peptide bond and primary structure, secondary structure, fibrous/globular proteins and denaturing, biological functions of proteins, enzymes and the lock and key model, factors affecting enzyme activity, inhibitors, simple lipids, compound lipids, derived lipids, importance of lipids, nucleic acids, the Watson-Crick DNA structure, DNA vs RNA, genes and protein synthesis, minerals. Numericals (polysaccharide n and glucose from hydrolysis, glucose energy, carbonic anhydrase turnover, DNA base pairs and hydrogen bonds) use new values recomputed in Python. Exercise descriptive questions Q4-Q7 are not repeated. Book corrections followed (sucrose disaccharide, rings in solution, 10⁶ per second, non-covalent reversible inhibitor, penicillin, isoprene formula, 100 mg per day).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
